heading: Evaluate the list with PM and EM regarding of the visibility and feasibility for both short-term and long-term planning.

blocks.html: We began developing concepts and ideas, framing them within a process driven format. Subsequently, we voted, organized, and discussed the ideas on which we reached the highest consensus.
Short - term: We plan to maintain a pure one-on-one chat with AI, focusing on enhancing emotional interactions to increase the number of DAUs.
Long - term: After gaining popularity, we plan to introduce group chat and community functions to stimulate more creativity and playability in the product.
